title: nf-core/gwasqc pipeline - params.reference_pop_data schema
description: Schema for the reference population table provided with params.reference_pop_data. One row labels one reference sample with its population and super-population; the super-population labels are the groups the ancestry classifier learns and the labels a samplesheet ancestry column is matched against.

FID.description: Family ID of the reference sample, as in its fam file.
FID.errorMessage: FID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

IID.description: Individual ID of the reference sample, as in its fam file.
IID.errorMessage: IID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

pop.description: Population label of the sample, such as GBR or YRI; carried into the projection table.
pop.errorMessage: pop must be provided and cannot contain spaces

super_pop.description: Super-population label of the sample, such as EUR or AFR; the group the classifier assigns study samples to and the vocabulary of the samplesheet ancestry column.
super_pop.errorMessage: super_pop must be provided, must start with a letter or digit and may contain only letters, digits, underscores, dots and dashes
